description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill mappings are attached to sections. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in the batch, not that the section has no mechanic. Null page_tags means the batch did not record a page-level tag list.

sections.name: The Main Course
sections.description_summary: When Voracia damages at least three enemies (or all surviving enemies), the skill gains Fervor. Active cast pulls enemies within 2 tiles onto a plate, knocks them down, deals damage and heals Voracia based on actual damage dealt.

sections.name: Prime Cut
sections.description_summary: Slashes the area with the most enemies; if enhanced by Fervor, performs an additional slash.

sections.name: Vino Inferno
sections.description_summary: Splashes wine over an area and roasts enemies for 5 seconds; Fervor adds an extra flame burst.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK, with another ATK bonus after appetite awakens.

sections.name: Chef's Choice
sections.description_summary: After all skills gain Fervor, devours the enemy with highest cumulative damage, absorbs part of their basic stats and permanently removes their Energy if they are not a Boss. Higher levels increase stat absorption and can devour a second target.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The Main Course also inflicts max-HP reduction equal to 35% of damage dealt.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening damage and Haste bonus for 12 seconds; higher ranks restore HP and extend the effect after assisting or defeating a non-summoned enemy.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Ultimate casts grant a temporary damage dealt bonus; first Ultimate also permanently increases Energy recovery from attacking. Refine adds Haste and DEF Penetration.

sections.name: Funereal Ring
sections.description_summary: Summons a tombstone where Igor stands at battle start. Whenever an enemy hero loses 40% HP, Igor summons another tombstone on an empty tile closest to that enemy. Igor remains steadfast on tombstones; casting deals damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Ghastly Explosion
sections.description_summary: Activates tombstones every 8 seconds or when Funereal Ring is cast. Igor jumps to an active tombstone, damages adjacent enemies and becomes immune/untargetable while casting.

sections.name: Specter Guard
sections.description_summary: Jumps to another tombstone to dodge a fatal blow and gains damage immunity. Tombstone jumps also restore HP.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Life Drain, with an extra bonus on first Specter Guard trigger.

sections.name: Horror Strike
sections.description_summary: Extends Ghastly Explosion range and reduces healing received by targets while Igor is above 70% HP. Higher levels let each Specter Guard enhance Ghastly Explosion.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Summons an extra tombstone with Funereal Ring on the tile with the most surrounding enemies at battle start.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Deals periodic magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals Igor based on actual damage dealt; higher ranks increase values and grant opening unaffected duration.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 seconds; refine adds Life Drain and Execution.

sections.name: Devastating Axe
sections.description_summary: Knocks down an enemy, deals damage and applies three stacks of Shatter Armor; each stack reduces target Phys DEF. If Kruger is present, allies apply an extra Shatter Armor stack when reducing enemy Phys DEF.

sections.name: Smashing Assault
sections.description_summary: Deals damage and applies one stack of Shatter Armor.

sections.name: Vital Strike
sections.description_summary: Attacks adjacent enemies with at least four Shatter Armor stacks and not affected by Vulnerable; deals damage and inflicts Vulnerable. Vulnerable enemies take increased physical damage, and part of damage taken is converted to Kruger's HP.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Ranged DEF.

sections.name: Ruthless Vanguard
sections.description_summary: At battle start, if no ally is within 1 tile, grants Kruger a shield and control immunity; also grants Life Drain while no ally is nearby. Higher level removes Vital Strike's distance limit.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When a Vulnerable enemy is defeated by Vital Strike, Kruger gains a 40% ATK boost until battle ends, stacking twice.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Deals periodic magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals Kruger based on actual damage dealt; higher ranks increase values and grant opening unaffected duration.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 seconds; refine adds Life Drain and Ranged DEF.

sections.name: Detention Pass
sections.description_summary: Starts with Contess hidden inside her rulebook, untargetable and recovering Energy until a trigger condition occurs. Active effect heals an ally and grants Exemption; Exemption converts some HP loss into a shield and grants ATK while the shield holds. The Ultimate also has an active effect healing the two weakest allies and reducing ATK of the two highest-damage enemies.

sections.name: Quiet Period
sections.description_summary: Whenever a unit casts an Ultimate, they violate Be Quiet. Contess reduces Energy recovery efficiency of the two enemies who have cast the most Ultimates.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Each enemy rule violation permanently reduces their ATK and Energy recovery efficiency, up to caps.

sections.name: Expulsion Notice
sections.description_summary: Units punished more than six times are permanently expelled, silenced and suffer additional HP loss; allies with Exemption are excluded.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Stuns enemies who violate Be Civil and silences enemies who violate Be Quiet; in Boss battles, applies an extra punishment for rule violations.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Healing an ally increases their ATK for 8 seconds; higher ranks increase Contess's Healing after a total-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: The first ally below 40% HP is healed and shielded; refine adds Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Six-Shot
sections.description_summary: Loads six bullets and randomly shoots enemies in front, prioritizing targets not yet hit during the cast. Each bullet deals ATK damage plus target-max-HP-based bonus damage and stuns; repeated hits on the same target deal reduced damage. Bounty Pursuit targets receive remaining bullets after other targets are hit.

sections.name: Shotgun Blast
sections.description_summary: Fires three penetrative bullets at enemies in the frontal area; main target is hit by all three. Normal attack range cannot be buffed further.

sections.name: Bounty Pursuit
sections.description_summary: 10 seconds after battle starts, marks the enemy with highest accumulated damage. Walker prioritizes them, deals increased damage and takes reduced damage; defeating the target grants Crit. Higher levels allow a new bounty after the previous target is defeated.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit DMG Boost.

sections.name: Aerial Thunder
sections.description_summary: At battle start throws grenades at three enemies, then detonates them, stunning, damaging and reducing Phys DEF of enemies in a 1-tile arc.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: First damage to the bounty target grants Walker a shield lasting until that target is defeated. LV 2 adds Crit and improves critical normal attacks against the bounty target.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit; critical hits splash damage to nearby enemies. Higher ranks convert some critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Opening, assist or defeat grants Penetration and Haste; refine adds DEF Penetration and Crit DMG Boost.

sections.name: Hailing Arrows
sections.description_summary: Passive charged normal attack deals 360% ATK; active cast rains arrows over a selected tile and surrounding area, damaging and immobilizing enemies. Repeated hits on the same target in a wave deal reduced damage.

sections.name: Fulgur Arrow
sections.description_summary: Every third normal attack is lightning-imbued, silencing the target and splashing damage/stun to enemies within 2 tiles.

sections.name: Flare Arrow
sections.description_summary: The second attack in Gwyneth's normal attack cycle deals damage and burns the target, periodically damaging them and reducing Vitality.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD; if no enemies are within 1 tile for 3 seconds, gains additional ATK SPD.

sections.name: Fulgur Flare
sections.description_summary: Increases normal attack damage and imbues the first attack with both lightning and fire. Higher level adds target-max-HP-based damage and ignores portions of damage reduction.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: If no enemy is within 1 tile for 3 seconds, reduces the interval between Gwyneth's normal attacks by 40%.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and heals based on normal-attack damage; higher ranks add Penetration while above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks stack ATK SPD and normal attack damage; refine adds ATK SPD and Crit DMG Boost.

sections.name: Fatal Waltz
sections.description_summary: Summons a magical rapier at a location; rapidly slashes enemies within 1 tile, then erupts in a burst damaging and stunning them.

sections.name: Fervent Flurry
sections.description_summary: Opening passive enchants the rapier for 15 seconds, increases Energy recovery and applies stacking Sear whenever skills or normal attacks deal damage. Active cast thrusts four times.

sections.name: Velvet Glove
sections.description_summary: When an ally grants Orion a temporary stat buff, extends his rapier enchantment and makes that ally a Supporter. Active cast damages enemies in a frontal arc and grants Orion a shield; Supporters gain part of that shield.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; gains extra ATK while Supporters are on the battlefield.

sections.name: Royal Prerogative
sections.description_summary: Each Supporter grants Authority, increasing damage dealt, reducing damage taken and extending Sear. At three stacks, permanently activates rapier enchantment and upgrades Sear to silence and reduce Vitality.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After three Authority stacks, Orion becomes unaffected for the rest of battle and Sear deals extra true damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken, amplified while on enemy side; higher ranks grant a permanent shield on first entry to enemy territory.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 seconds; refine adds Crit and Ranged DEF.

sections.name: Mid-Air Shot
sections.description_summary: Leaps up to 2 tiles in any direction and shoots the two closest enemies to her initial tile.

sections.name: Mighty Arrow
sections.description_summary: After every two normal attacks, charges the next attack to deal extra damage and briefly stun the target.

sections.name: Hyperfocus
sections.description_summary: While no enemy is within 2 tiles, increases ATK and ATK SPD.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit DMG Boost.

sections.name: Battlefield Learning
sections.description_summary: Each allied Ultimate increases Marilee's ATK, stacking up to six times. At max stacks, normal attacks deal true damage. Higher level grants an extra stack when Hyperfocus activates.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Reduces the no-enemy distance required for Hyperfocus by 1 tile.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and heals based on normal-attack damage; higher ranks add Penetration while above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks stack ATK SPD and normal attack damage; refine adds ATK SPD and Crit.

sections.name: Heroic Slash
sections.description_summary: Performs nine consecutive slashes in a frontal area, followed by a sweep dealing damage plus true damage based on target max HP.

sections.name: Heroic Dash
sections.description_summary: Dashes to the two enemies with highest cumulative damage, damages and knocks them down, then returns to original position.

sections.name: Hero Party
sections.description_summary: If at least one Mage, Tank and Support are adjacent, forms a party with himself and one ally of each class, increasing basic stats and granting a shared permanent shield. Active cast damages a target and converts part of damage into healing for party members. Page gives class/row/hex-ID targeting priorities.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Blue-Moon Blessings
sections.description_summary: Grants party members class-specific max HP or ATK bonuses based on Himmel's initial ATK; if Frieren is in the party, grants both Himmel and Frieren Penetration. Later sweep heals and removes debuffs.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: In Boss fights, Himmel and party members cause 12% more HP loss on Boss targets.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK when the caster is displaced by their own skills; higher ranks add a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 seconds; refine adds Crit and Ranged DEF.
